structure_path.description: Absolute path to the input structure (PDB or mmCIF) to analyze for residue burial, secondary structure, interface contacts, and liability flags.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream structure tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `structure_path` when omitted.

sequence.description: Optional reference sequence for mapping integer `positions` onto PDB residue ids. Null uses the sequence implied by the structure.

fasta_path.description: Alternative to inline `sequence`: a FASTA file with the reference sequence.

position_basis.description: How to interpret integer `positions`. `auto` picks sequence when a reference sequence is provided, else structure.

chain_id.description: Restrict analysis to a single chain id. Null analyzes all chains.

interface_chain_ids.description: Optional list of chain ids whose pairwise interfaces should be analyzed. Empty list reports every cross-chain interface.

ligand_resnames.description: PDB residue names (CCD codes) of ligands/cofactors to analyze for contacts.

positions.description: FASTA/sequence 1-indexed positions to annotate when `sequence`/`fasta_path` is provided; otherwise legacy structure residue numbers.

max_annotations.description: Cap on the number of per-residue annotations emitted in the artifact (caps both auto-selected and explicit positions).

contact_distance_angstrom.description: Inter-atom distance threshold in Å for counting an inter-residue (or residue-ligand) contact.

surface_rsa_threshold.description: Relative-solvent-accessibility threshold above which a residue is labelled `exposed`.

buried_rsa_threshold.description: Relative-solvent-accessibility threshold below which a residue is labelled `buried`.

run_dssp.description: When true, assign secondary structure using pydssp first, then mkdssp/dssp if pydssp is unavailable, then a CA-geometry heuristic. Disable to use the heuristic directly when only contact/RSA analysis is needed.

output_prefix.description: Filename prefix for generated TSV/JSON artifacts. Filesystem-safe characters only.
